title: Loyalty programmes judged with a holdout
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: Whether a loyalty card, VIP club or cross-sell programme adds sales, judged against a holdout rather than members vs non-members.
applies_when: Owner runs or plans a loyalty programme
exclusions: No loyalty programme planned or running
required_inputs: Member and non-member counts and visits
Ability to hold out a group
evidence_requirements: pre-period purchase history for members and non-members
who joins (existing heavy, existing light, new)
program cost incl. rewards given to people who would buy anyway
missing_data_behavior: No holdout possible: label results 'members already buy more'; no uplift claim.

decision_branches.then: Compare members vs holdout on visits per customer.

decision_branches.if: Loyalty is the only retention play
decision_branches.then: Warn; add a retention play that works on value.

implementation_steps: Cost rewards paid to buyers who would have bought anyway
Set an evaluation design before launch (holdout or pre/post on same customers)
dependencies: consented contacts for any messaging (existing rule)
metrics: share of members who were new
guardrails: Card completion is not extra sales.
Never report member-vs-non-member gaps as program effect
alternatives_when_constrained: No POS IDs: measure total visits vs prior-year same weeks, labelled weak
Small shop: a simple stamp card with no big promise
stop_conditions: If incremental visits vs holdout are ~0 after 90 days, keep only if the list/data job justifies the cost
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Endowed-progress cards raise completion rates; completion isn't incremental sales
Coalition programs with competitor-store recruitment are rare

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed rule: loyalty-program plays state their job (list, data, frequency nudge) and cannot be the only retention or growth play
proposed rule: diagnosis playStage treats 'loyalty program' as retention only when paired with a churn-reason fix

missing_prerequisite.rule: proposed rule: evaluation of loyalty/VIP plays requires a holdout or same-customer pre/post; member vs non-member comparisons are rejected

reconciliation_note: Contradicts the 'evidence strong' rating in plays-local (RECONCILIATION R06).
